description: Newly registered look-alikes of a brand: names that entered the gTLD and .com/.net zones in the last 14 days and are a typo, a look-alike-character spelling (paypa1), the same name on another TLD, or the brand beside a lure word (paypal-login). Each with a risk tier and the reasons. Derived matches only, at most 50 — never a raw list of new domains. Price $0.020 per call. Free sample: {"brand": "example"}. Returns: data: brand, window{from,to,days}, matches[{domain, day, kind, matched, lures, tier, score, signals, ns{provider,hint}, census{state,registrar}, risk{tier,verdict,target}}], window_totals{total, by_tier, by_kind, listed_cap}, variants_searched, saturated, note.

brand.description: A brand name or one of its domains, e.g. paypal or paypal.com (4-30 characters)

days.description: Only names new in the last N zone days (default 14)

min_tier.description: Only matches at or above this tier

name: brand_lookalikes
title: Brand look-alike domains
